task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"as is, no warranty","id":"gh:1330791921","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"turtle-ui","slug":"turtle1999/turtle-ui","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# Turtle UI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> The very first UI of dsh in a Friday afternoon"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"This repository contains the former `packages/ui/tui` implementation, its unit and terminal snapshot"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" tests, and a dsh profile bundle patch. The TUI owns terminal presentation and input; DeepSeek Harne"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ss owns the agent, model, tools, persistence, and `dsh` launcher."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Keep this repository and DeepSeek Harness as siblings:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Install and build the sibling Harness, then Turtle UI:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The peer APIs come from the sibling Harness checkout. The standalone TypeScript and Vitest configura"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"tions intentionally resolve those sources through `../deepseek-harness`; Vitest uses the Harness bui"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ld for the goal host module instead of mixing that source module with transitive built packages. The"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" patched `@earendil-works/pi-tui` is a devDependency bundled into `lib/` at build time, so consumers"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" install no pi-tui and need no `patchedDependencies`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Run"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Turtle UI is a dsh profile bundle: its `package.json` declares `\"dsh\": { \"bundle\": { \"patch\": \"./cor"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"dis.patch.yml\" } }`, so installing it into a profile activates the patch layer automatically."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"From a local checkout, build and install a copied `file:` package so its Harness peers resolve throu"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"gh the profile's managed fallback. Re-run the add after rebuilding to refresh the copy:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"From git, with no checkout: the `prepare` script transpiles `lib/` on the consumer's machine during "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"install. pnpm ≥10 blocks that build until you allow it, so the first `add` fails with an `allowBuild"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s` hint; copy the exact key pnpm prints into the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The `prepare` build (`tsdown.prepare.config.ts`) transpiles without type checking — the repo's type "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"graph needs the sibling harness checkout, which consumers don't have. `pnpm run typecheck` in a sibl"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ing-checkout environment remains the type gate."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The bundle layer rides over `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` and binds the TUI and configured agent to one du"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rable session. The ordinary `tui-startup` provider injects the launcher's immutable `ctx.cmdlineArgs"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"`, parses `--resume`, `--session`, and this app's `--help`, then provides `tuiStartup`; session-boun"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"d rows inject that service and read it from lazy config, so they cannot activate on the wrong sessio"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"n. A bare `dsh --profile tui` mints a fresh session id on every launch, `--session <id>` names a fre"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"sh session explicitly, and `--resume <session>` continues a persisted session. In-app `/resume` hand"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"off and exit-message behavior still need the removed TUI-specific launcher and remain unavailable."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Checks"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":false}
